title: Choco Pixel
description:
Choco Pixel is a colorful 2D pixel-art logic puzzle where you guide a small toy car through a world inspired by chocolate and sweets. Your goal is to reach the finish across 50 levels without falling into traps or getting stuck in dead ends.

Choose the Right DirectionMove the car in four directions and study each layout before choosing your route. The challenge is to find a safe sequence of moves that leads to the finish. Careful planning matters more than speed.

A Sweet Pixel-Art PuzzleMinimalist visuals, bright colors, and a cheerful soundtrack give these logic challenges a playful atmosphere.

Key Features• 50 puzzle levels with routes to work out.

• Four-direction movement to guide the toy car.

• Traps and dead ends that reward thinking ahead.

• Route-planning challenges built around simple rules.

• Colorful pixel art with chocolate and sweets.

• Music to accompany each puzzle.

• 100 Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud support.

• Single-player gameplay focused on logic.

Choose your route, avoid the traps, and drive the toy car to the finish!
description_short: Choco Pixel is a colorful 2D pixel-art puzzle game where you guide a toy car through 50 chocolate-themed levels. Move in four directions, plan each route, avoid traps and dead ends, and reach the finish. Enjoy minimalist visuals, sweet treats, and clever spatial challenges.
